We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have guidance: three steps: (1) sulfonamide formation (sulfonyl chloride + amine). (2) Doebner modification to form the α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid (the C=C and carboxylic acid). (3) amide formation from carboxylic acid + amine (coupling). So retrosynthetic direction: target -> break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride precursor and an aniline (the aryl amine). Also break amide to give carboxylic acid and aniline (the second aniline). Also break the α,β-unsaturated acid to give aldehyde + malonic acid (Doebner). So we need to produce a route with 3 reactions.

Thus we need to produce JSON route: root molecule target, child reaction 1 (last step forward) is amide coupling: template for amide formation (carboxylic acid + amine). The precursors: the unsaturated acid (C=C-COOH attached to aromatic) and aniline (Nc3ccccc3N? Actually the amide is C(=O)N attached to aniline (c3ccccc3N). The amide is C(=O)N attached to aniline that also has an NH2? Wait target: .../C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N. So the amide carbonyl attached to an aniline that also has an NH2 (para? Actually c3ccccc3N is an aniline (aniline). So the amide precursor is the α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid (with C=O) attached to aromatic ring (c2ccc(... )cc2) and the amine is an aniline (c3ccccc3N). So step 1: amide formation.

Step 2: Doebner modification: produce α,β-unsaturated acid from aromatic aldehyde (the aldehyde is attached to same aromatic ring) and malonic acid. The aldehyde is the aromatic aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2). So we need to break the C=C and carboxylic acid to aldehyde + malonic acid.

Step 3: sulfonamide formation: break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride attached to aromatic ring (c2ccc(SO2Cl)cc2) and aniline (the first aromatic amine attached to methyl phenyl). Actually sulfonamide is NS(=O)(=O) attached to aromatic ring (c1ccc(N... )cc1). The sulfonamide formed between an aniline (the first phenyl with methyl) and sulfonyl chloride attached to second phenyl. So precursors: aniline (p-toluidine) and sulfonyl chloride (p-chlorosulfonyl phenyl? Actually the sulfonyl chloride is attached to the second phenyl ring (c2ccc(... )cc2). So we need sulfonyl chloride attached to that phenyl.

Thus we need to find template IDs for these transformations. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria to find templates for amide formation (functional_groups_broken: aliphatic carboxylic acid; functional_groups_formed: amide). Also for Doebner (C-C double bond formed, C-C bond broken, C-O bond broken). Might be tricky.

Simplify: we can just propose route without verifying templates; but need to include template IDs. Could use placeholder IDs? Probably need real IDs from database. Let's try to search for amide formation template.
